name: Lightforce 170 Striker Halogen
description:
Internationally recognized, the computer designed parabolic reflector and lightweight ergonomic design delivers a spotlight that is unequalled in light output, quality, durability and user comfort.

 LIGHTFORCE produces a wide range of lights, designed to enhance any situation that requires superior portable lighting that will not let you down. Typical uses include hunting, fishing, boating, camping, security, military and police, surveillance and the observation of nocturnal animals.

 3 REFLECTOR SIZES to suit any application you need!

 • 140mm ‘Lance’ (Compact but surprisingly powerful)

 • 170mm ‘Striker’ (Our most popular performer)

 • 240mm ‘Blitz’ (simply unequalled powerful and brilliance)

 Now that’s a bright idea! 

 The insert in the bottom of the handle, can house a spare bulb that can be easily replaced in the field without tools.

 Get connected with two power cable options, your choice!

 • 4.5 metre figure 8 flex with alligator clips

 • 3.6 metre coil cord with cigarette lighter

 COMPARE THE FEATURES!

 • Lightweight, hi-tech engineering polymer construction for extreme strength and durability

 • Computer designed parabolic r

name: Nitecore MT40GT Rechargeable Kit
description:
High intensity CREE XP-L LED | 1000 lumens | 620m max. beam distance 

 Switchable modes through head rotating | IPX-8 waterproof 

 Includes Li-ion/NiMH/NiCd battery charger, car charging cable & more 

 Beginning with just a DIY flashlight, Nitecore have flourished into an innovative company since its 2004 founding. With patented designs for adventure-seekers of all kinds, when faced with a dark path, make sure it’s Nitecore lighting your way.

 Features: 

 Nitecore lighting & accessories

 Model: MT40GT Rechargeable Hunting Kit

 Multi-Task Series

 Colour: Black

 Package contents:
 
 MT40GT flashlight

 Intellicharger i2

 2 x 18650 Li-ion rechargeable batteries

 Li-ion/NiMH/NiCd battery charger

 Car charging cable

 Holster

 Lanyard

 Ideal for search & rescue, law enforcement, military use & hiking

 High performance CREE XP-L LED

 Fresnel lens for intense beam concentration

 Switchable modes through head rotating:
 
 Low | Mid | High | Turbo

 Strobe

 SOS

 User-defined mode for customised brightness levels

 High efficiency current circuit board

 Anti-rolling design

 Reverse polarity protection

 Impact resistant to 1.5m

 Aero grade alumin

name: POWA BEAM DELUXE REMOTE CONTROL HANDLE QUICK LOCK
description:
POWA BEAM DELUXE REMOTE CONTROL HANDLE QUICK LOCK

 Upgraded version of the popular Powa Beam Deluxe Remote. Now with a quicker, easier and more secure folding mechanism and a larger grip.

 Features:

 Quick Release Handle folds flush with roof

 Housing machined from aircraft grade alloy

 One piece steel ball joint with internal wiring

 Reversible long wearing, self lubricating ball joint washers

 50Deg maximum tilt, 360Deg maximum rotation

 Super smooth operation

 Switch conveniently located on handle

 Adjustable tension control from inside cabin with locking ring

 Handle folds down to approx 350mm below roof

 For use with all Powa Beam Spotlights

 All parts are replaceable
